claims: Continue continuous cardiac and hemodynamic monitoring with arterial line and ST-segment surveillance.
Monitor serum potassium and replace as needed given hypokalemia (3.4 mEq/L).
Monitor blood glucose and treat hyperglycemia as needed (fingerstick 127–132 mg/dL).
Assess and manage right lower extremity weakness (strength 2/5) with physical therapy and fall precautions.
Maintain bed rest with fall precautions given bedfast status and right leg weakness.
Continue sequential compression devices or other VTE prophylaxis while immobilized.
Monitor renal function and electrolytes with daily basic metabolic panel.
Provide bowel regimen with scheduled docusate and as-needed bisacodyl/senna to prevent constipation.
Assess and manage pain with as-needed acetaminophen, monitoring response.
Maintain head-of-bed elevation and monitor for aspiration risk given dysphagia screen negative but bedfast status.
